content: Prisma 7 requires Node >=20.19.0, a mandatory prisma.config.ts at project root (schema/migrations/datasource via env()), generator provider must be 'prisma-client' (not prisma-client-js) with a required custom output path, and every datasource needs an explicit driver adapter (@prisma/adapter-pg for Postgres) passed to . moduleFormat can be set to 'cjs' to avoid forcing ESM on consuming CommonJS apps.
